author: laurelyn ashley-diehl
text: Milty the septic guy came out promptly and was very professional. He was very reasonably priced, especially in light of the other quotes we received for the business Jenks. We used him to replace the entire tank and system. We used in the past years ago and we will use him the future.

author: Mark Weigt
text: Couldn’t be happier with the service received in installing my new septic system. Milty and his crew were on time, prepared, and professional. I especially loved Milty’s charisma and positive attitude during the install, he makes the work fun and it was a pleasure working with him and his crew to install my new septic system.

author: Tricia Hobson
text: Trey and Anthony installed a new aerobic system for us. They did an outstanding job very hard workers!

author: Michael
text: Milty’s did a fantastic job! I am typically left disappointed with the subpar service of most companies nowadays, but this was a very pleasant experience, even more so considering the work being done. :). They showed up on time, communicated clearly and precisely on what was being done, what was needed, and got to work immediately. My 25+ year old septic is back in fighting shape. If you need septic work done, don’t hesitate to make the call. They will take good care of you.

author: NANA
text: The young man that came out was very polite and friendly.  He answered my questions and explained everything that I asked about. It was outstanding service!!!  Thank you so much 🙏😊
